# Introduction {#sec-introduction}

This collection brings together the currently available publication editions of Bahá’u’lláh's writings. The tablets are arranged in numerical order by their BH identifiers. The order is provisional and does not imply chronology.

The texts preserve the original-language passage, transliteration, and contemporary English translation from the publication editions.
